name: Ahmed Johnson
caption: Dominated most of his match for the vacant NEWCOWF TV Title before Ric Flair caught him with a low blow and the figure-four for the pin at the promotion's Tournament Finals.

tenures.source: the federation's own Tournament Finals Results (8 June 1997), served at newcowf-1997/archive/newcowf-tournament-finals-1997-06-08.html

name: Ric Flair
caption: The federation's first NEWCOWF TV Champion, catching Ahmed Johnson with a low blow and the figure-four for the pin at the promotion's Tournament Finals, before losing the title to Chris Benoit at Triple Threat '97.

tenures.source: the federation's own Tournament Finals Results (8 June 1997) and Triple Threat '97 results (29 June 1997, losing the NEWCOWF TV Title to Chris Benoit), served at newcowf-1997/archive/

identity.note: A real wrestler also portrayed by other promotions; each promotion's portrayal is its own record.

name: Ken Shamrock
caption: Left unconscious alongside Vader after special referee Taz turned on both men at the finish of their bonus bout at the promotion's Tournament Finals, then won the NEWCOWF TV Title from Chris Benoit at Clash in the Champions House.

tenures.source: the federation's own Tournament Finals Results (8 June 1997), Triple Threat '97 results (29 June 1997, winning a three-way shootfight) and Clash in the Champions House results (13 July 1997, winning the NEWCOWF TV Title), served at newcowf-1997/archive/

identity.note: A real wrestler also portrayed by other promotions; each promotion's portrayal is its own record.

name: Vader
caption: Powerbombed Ken Shamrock four times in a bonus bout before special referee Taz turned on both men at the finish, at the promotion's Tournament Finals.

tenures.source: the federation's own Tournament Finals Results (8 June 1997) and Triple Threat '97 results (29 June 1997, a three-way shootfight), served at newcowf-1997/archive/

name: Doug Furnas
caption: Half of the tag team pinned by the debuting Eliminators for the promotion's first NEWCOWF Tag Team Title at its Tournament Finals.

tenures.source: the federation's own Tournament Finals Results (8 June 1997), served at newcowf-1997/archive/newcowf-tournament-finals-1997-06-08.html

name: Philip LaFon
caption: Doug Furnas's tag partner, on the losing end of the promotion's first NEWCOWF Tag Team Title match at its Tournament Finals.

tenures.source: the federation's own Tournament Finals Results (8 June 1997), served at newcowf-1997/archive/newcowf-tournament-finals-1997-06-08.html

name: John Kronus
caption: Wrestled most of the promotion's first NEWCOWF Tag Team Title match alone while his injured partner Perry Saturn waited on the apron at the Tournament Finals, then lost the title at Triple Threat '97 teaming with a substitute for the still-injured Saturn.

tenures.source: the federation's own Tournament Finals Results (8 June 1997) and Triple Threat '97 results (29 June 1997, losing the NEWCOWF Tag Team Title to Sabu and Rob Van Dam), served at newcowf-1997/archive/

name: Perry Saturn
caption: Tagged himself in on an injured leg and scored the pinfall that won the promotion's first NEWCOWF Tag Team Title at its Tournament Finals.

tenures.source: the federation's own Tournament Finals Results (8 June 1997), served at newcowf-1997/archive/newcowf-tournament-finals-1997-06-08.html

name: Bret Hart
caption: Used a chair shot and the Sharpshooter to beat Sting in a bonus bout at the promotion's Tournament Finals.

tenures.source: the federation's own Tournament Finals Results (8 June 1997), Triple Threat '97 results (29 June 1997) and Great Canadian Bash results (25 August 1997), all NEWCOWF World Title challenges against Steve Austin, served at newcowf-1997/archive/

name: Sting
caption: Cleared the ring with a baseball bat before losing to Bret Hart's Sharpshooter in a bonus bout at the promotion's Tournament Finals.

tenures.source: the federation's own Tournament Finals Results (8 June 1997) and Triple Threat '97 results (29 June 1997, a NEWCOWF World Title challenge), served at newcowf-1997/archive/

name: Steve Austin
caption: Beat The Giant with three consecutive Stone Cold Stunners to become the promotion's first NEWCOWF World Champion at its Tournament Finals.

tenures.source: the federation's own Tournament Finals Results (8 June 1997), Triple Threat '97 results (29 June 1997) and Great Canadian Bash results (25 August 1997), all retaining the NEWCOWF World Title, served at newcowf-1997/archive/

name: The Giant
caption: Chokeslammed Stone Cold Steve Austin but was pinned after three consecutive Stone Cold Stunners at the promotion's Tournament Finals, deciding its first NEWCOWF World Title.

tenures.source: the federation's own Tournament Finals Results (8 June 1997), served at newcowf-1997/archive/newcowf-tournament-finals-1997-06-08.html

name: Chris Benoit
caption: Won the NEWCOWF TV Title from Ric Flair at Triple Threat '97, lost it to Ken Shamrock at Clash in the Champions House, then reclaimed it and defended it through the promotion's last surviving cards.

tenures.source: the federation's own Triple Threat '97 (29 June 1997), Clash in the Champions House (13 July 1997) and Great Canadian Bash (24 August 1997) results, served at newcowf-1997/archive/; its own Great Canadian Bash, Hockeytown Heaven 97 and Halloween Hangover 97 vote cards go on billing him NEWCOWF TV Champion through the fed's last surviving post (12 October 1997).

name: Sabu
caption: Won the NEWCOWF Tag Team Title alongside Rob Van Dam at Triple Threat '97, retained it at Clash in the Champions House, and was one of the two champions left standing in the four-way draw that saw the title held up at the Great Canadian Bash.

tenures.source: the federation's own Triple Threat '97 (29 June 1997) and Clash in the Champions House (13 July 1997) results, served at newcowf-1997/archive/; its own Great Canadian Bash results (25 August 1997) and Halloween Hangover 97 vote card (12 October 1997) go on billing him a NEWCOWF Tag Team Champion.

name: Rob Van Dam
caption: Pinned Tommy Dreamer with a split-legged moonsault to win the NEWCOWF Tag Team Title alongside Sabu at Triple Threat '97, and retained it with him at Clash in the Champions House.

tenures.source: the federation's own Triple Threat '97 (29 June 1997) and Clash in the Champions House (13 July 1997) results, served at newcowf-1997/archive/; its own Great Canadian Bash results (25 August 1997) and Halloween Hangover 97 vote card (12 October 1997) go on billing him a NEWCOWF Tag Team Champion.

name: Tommy Dreamer
caption: Substituted for an injured Perry Saturn to defend the NEWCOWF Tag Team Title alongside John Kronus at Triple Threat '97, losing it to Sabu and Rob Van Dam.

tenures.source: the federation's own Triple Threat '97 results (29 June 1997), served at newcowf-1997/archive/newcowf-triple-threat-97-1997-06-29.html.

name: Taz
caption: Made Vader tap to the Tazmission in a three-way shootfight at Triple Threat '97 before submitting himself to Ken Shamrock's torque leglock, the same year he served as the promotion's special referee at its Tournament Finals.

tenures.source: the federation's own Triple Threat '97 results (29 June 1997), served at newcowf-1997/archive/newcowf-triple-threat-97-1997-06-29.html; he had earlier served as a non-participant special referee at the promotion's own Tournament Finals (8 June 1997).
